map.做团队佣金预算：给定总业绩与阶梯，预估佣金总额，控制销售费用占比。: Plan team commission budgets: given total performance and tiers, estimate total commission and keep the selling expense ratio under control.
map.可在参数里设封顶值（超过不再计提）与个税免征额（默认 0 或 5000），工具在: You can set a cap in the parameters (no further accrual above it) and a tax-free allowance (default 0 or 5000); the tool estimates tax after totalling. The cap prevents a single abnormal item from inflating cost.
map.同一 50 万业绩，超额累进为 29000 元，全额累进为 40000 元；业绩: For the same 500,000 performance, graduated excess gives 29,000 CNY while flat-on-total gives 40,000 CNY; the higher the performance and the wider the tier gaps, the larger the difference. Graduated excess is smoother and more common.
map.封顶与免征额怎么处理？: How are the cap and the allowance handled?
map.录入销售额与自定义提成阶梯（超额累进或全额累进），工具分段计算各档佣金并汇总提成: Enter sales figures and a custom commission tier (graduated excess or flat-on-total); the tool computes commission per tier and sums the total, supporting multiple rates and caps, which makes sales team pay easy to settle.
map.核算单笔大单佣金：大额订单跨多档时，确认每一档的边界与计提比例，避免漏算高档部分: Checking single large-deal commission: when a large order spans several tiers, confirm the boundary and accrual rate of each tier so the top tier is not missed.
map.设计阶梯提成政策：录入多档销售额阈值与提成比例，按超额累进或全额累进自动分段计算: Design a tiered commission policy: enter multi-tier sales thresholds and commission rates and the tool splits the commission by graduated excess or flat-on-total, with cap support.
map.超额累进和全额累进差多少？: How much do graduated excess and flat-on-total differ?
